decision.reason: Raw fresh-process medians are retained, but a 9.326707032836223e-5 Eh/Bohr^2 inter-engine Hessian discrepancy exceeds 3e-6. No speed ratio or production promotion is qualified.

reproduction.prerequisites: Run from the measured source on the node2 Slurm controller; CUDA12.9 sm120/RTX PRO6000, Ninja/CMake, verified compiler cache, build-time compiler Python dependencies, and GPU4PySCF1.8.1/PySCF2.14.0/CuPy13.6.0. Preserve Slurm visibility; set REFERENCE_PYTHON and CUDA_ROOT. Shared-library search paths must include the installed reference dependencies. The complete reproduction script was not independently replayed.
reproduction.source_restore: Keep the bundle outside the checkout before restoring source.revision; the retained inventory is a finite selected closure, not complete orbital-f/auxiliary-g coverage.
